t: From Self-Hosting to Solarpunk: A Journey Towards Digital and Societal Independence
s: This document outlines a personal journey from self-hosting technology to embracing broader societal visions of independence, driven by a desire for resilience, control, and sustainability, leveraging AI as a learning tool.
sub: Incremental self-hosting of digital services (e.g., photos, code) using AI for skill acquisition.
Envisioning a solar-powered, connected mobile lifestyle (e.g., RV with Starlink).
Connecting personal tech autonomy with wider societal movements like Solarpunk and off-grid living.
Utilizing NixOS for declarative configuration and service interchangeability.
